programs.title: Hey You What If?
programs.sub_title: You Could Dig Through The Earth?
programs.desc: The deepest hole humankind ever dug only got 1/1000th of the way through the earth. But what would happen if you kept digging? You'd have to get through magma and the solid iron core which is hotter than the sun's surface!

programs.title: btn
programs.desc: BTN is a high-energy, fun way for Upper Primary and Secondary students to learn about current issues and events in their world. Each program is built around major news stories of the week.

programs.title: The Slow Mo Guys' Big Adventures
programs.desc: How amazing is liquid nitrogen? And what happens when you detonate it? As we find out the answers, Gav and Dan show that everything looks better in slow motion.

programs.title: Elevator Pitch
programs.desc: University of Sydney's Dr Alessandro Tuniz explains how scientists define light and as Rad Yeo discovers, the answer is not that simple.

programs.title: BtN Newsbreak
programs.desc: Find out what's going on in the world with a news bulletin designed for children, featuring stories that are relevant and easy to understand.

programs.title: Phil Spencer: Secret Agent Down Under
programs.desc: Anne and Laura have made the move to marvellous Melbourne to be nearer to Anne's family. They've got work sorted, now all they need is a place to call home. Enter our very own Secret Agent Phil.
